title: Classify vessels as fishing vs non-fishing using environmental context tiles + vessel length
description: Classify detected vessels as fishing or non-fishing using a multi-input mixed-data model (ConvNeXt-based). Inputs are (1) estimated vessel length from SAR (scalar) and (2) a multiband raster stack (11 bands) centered on the vessel, sampled as 100×100 tiles from 0.01° gridded fields (~1 km/pixel). The paper lists the 11 variables: vessel density (SAR), average vessel length (SAR), bathymetry, distance from port, hours of non-fishing AIS presence (<50 m), hours of non-fishing AIS presence (>50 m), average surface temperature, average current speed, std dev daily temperature, std dev daily current speed, average chlorophyll. Predictions use an ensemble of two models trained on spatially non-overlapping 'odd' and 'even' 1° grids; scores are calibrated using different fishing/non-fishing ratios.

outputs.vessel_activity_type: Fishing/non-fishing labels or probabilities for each detection
